excerpt: Scripbox is an Indian online wealth manager offering mutual fund investing, financial planning, PMS and fee-based advisory. Regular-fund investing is free; direct-fund advisory starts at 0.8% a year for portfolios over ₹50 lakh.
content:
Scripbox is an Indian digital wealth management company. Today its website describes Scripbox Wealth as offering portfolio management services (PMS), specialised investment funds (SIF), mutual fund distribution and fee-based advisory, and says it has been helping families towards financial freedom since 2012. Its app and website offer unbiased fund recommendations, personalised portfolio construction, continuous fund monitoring with exit alerts, goal-based financial planning and a Smart Withdraw tool designed to reduce tax on withdrawals, with access to more than 2,000 mutual funds for Indian residents, NRIs and OCIs.

Inc42 reported that Scripbox was founded in 2012 and simplifies mutual fund investing for salaried professionals; Atul Shinghal leads it as founder. Accel has backed it since its 2015 Series A. YourStory reported that in early 2019 Scripbox raised Rs 151 crore in a Series C led by Accel, with Omidyar Network and NLI Investment Fund participating. Inc42 later reported a $10.5 million Series D from existing investors Accel, NLI Investment Fund and KPB Family Trust. In January 2022 LetsVenture reported that Scripbox raised $21 million in debt and equity led by Accel, with Shinghal telling The Economic Times the money would go into acquiring customers and partnering with independent financial advisers.

Scripbox publishes its fees. Investing in regular mutual funds costs nothing directly, because Scripbox earns commission from fund houses (AMCs). For direct mutual funds, its fee-based advisory plan is for portfolios above ₹50 lakh and starts at 0.8% of the portfolio a year, plus GST, payable quarterly, with a minimum fee that may apply.

Mutual fund investments are subject to market risk. This profile is not investment advice. It draws on Scripbox's own pages and published reporting. We have not used the service, and nothing here is paid placement.
